text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“—Ugh, I just remembered it again... Those 
zombies from yesterday's movie...!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's no good! Freezing up out of 
fear is the worst thing you can do! A-At 
times like this...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Go! Stand up! Carrot~♪ Surging through my 
veins~ are love~ courage~ and 
ca~ro~te~ne~~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm feeling braver now! I'll keep 
singing until it doesn't bother me 
anymore...! ♪ Even down to my soul, I'm 
heaaalthyyy~ ♪
